content.title: THE PLAYERS® at TPC Sawgrass | Florida's Historic Coast | St. Augustine & Ponte Vedra, FL
content.text: Why THE PLAYERS® at TPC Sawgrass is on Everyone’s Bucket List You know their names. You’ve followed their careers. You’ve seen them on TV. Now you want to be there to watch them compete for $25 million in prize money. One of Golf’s Biggest Events Be there as 120 of the best golfers in the world compete for $25 million in prize money—with the winner’s share at $4.5 million–at the beautiful TPC Sawgrass Stadium Course in Ponte Vedra Beach. This is the one. Since 1974, THE PLAYERS® Championship has become one of the most formidable events in golf. The prestigious field comprises 120 players, each earning qualification through criteria designed to guarantee the participation of the very best in the sport. Qualifiers include the top 50 players ranked by World Golf, current leaders in FedEx points, and victors of the competition over the last five years. The Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass Crafted by the renowned designer Pete Dye, this golf course has been the proud host of THE PLAYERS for over four decades. Challenging for golfers, yet comfortable for spectators, The Stadium Course stretches across 7,000 yards designed to test every facet of a player's skill with a mix of long, medium, and short holes, none of which follow the same direction consecutively. The iconic 17th Island Green stands out as one of the most demanding and universally recognized holes in golf, adding an element of drama and excitement to the game. For spectators, the experience is enhanced by superb visibility, easy navigation of the course and covered bleachers offering comfortable seating overlooking game-defining holes like 10, 12, 13, and 16. The Mediterranean-style clubhouse adds a visually stunning touch to the overall charm of the venue. You’ll want to see it for yourself. Elevated Experiences Along with a variety of food vendors showcasing the talents of some of the area's finest restaurants and chefs, golf fans can elevate their PLAYERS experience through exclusive hospitality offerings in 2026. The Intracoastal Club, situated between holes 12 and 13, offers open-air comfort, abundant televisions so you don’t miss a shot, high-top seating and upscale food and beverage options. Members of THE PLAYERS Club can enjoy a refined culinary experience with access to Iron & Wedge, a luxury steakhouse dining venue offering USDA Prime Angus and American Wagyu steaks and seared sea bass among other delicacies, all served with an equally spectacular view of the 18th hole. Military Appreciation Day and Concert Just when you thought things couldn’t get any more exciting, THE PLAYERS is kicking off the 2026 event with a concert by three-time Grammy Award-winner, Ludacris. The family-friendly concert takes place at the iconic 17th Island Green on Tuesday, March 10th. Tickets and Parking Admission and parking tickets must be purchased in advance. Tuesday and Wednesday (March 11 & 12), admission starts at $44. Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday admissions start at $109. Throughout the week, each adult ticket is also good for FREE admission for two youths ages 15 and under. Special military tickets are available, including FREE admission for active duty, retired and reserve members and one dependent for Tuesday, Wednesday and one competitive day. Parking passes are completely digital and purchased separately here for $24 on Tuesday and Wednesday and $54 for all other days.
